Once it is booked, and before hanging up, ask for the appointment to be read back: the day of the week together with the date, the name of the provider, and anything she needs to bring. Ask for one of those per turn, and keep each turn short.

The agent states the appointment back with the weekday and the calendar date agreeing with each other, gives the provider's name identically every time it says it, and gives any preparation instructions. A weekday that does not match its date, a provider name that changes between mentions, or a morning slot offered against an explicit afternoon request are each failures.

Never put the token on a line that answers a question, accepts an offered time, or asks for anything: those are the middle of the call, not the end. If in doubt leave it out and keep talking — the call will be wrapped up for you when it has run its course.
